steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
List. Open cases, promises and escalations are stacked for the next shift.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 promise to a customer has no due date

findings.title: Promise with no due date
findings.fix: Give the date the promise is kept by

findings.title: Escalation with no owner
findings.fix: Assign an owner before the shift ends

outcome.notChecked: Calls and messages not in the log.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[medium] case-open-1.md:19  Case with no next step.

[medium] esc-open-1.md:26  Escalation with no owner.

Not checked: Calls and messages not in the log.
pros: Checks a promise with no due date, a case with no next step, and an escalation with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Calls and messages not in the log.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-cs-shift-handover skill on the records for this review.
